pkl_audit.training_vs_wfa_difference: Saved PKL was trained via MLFeatureEngine.train_and_select_top_features() on all 44,210 non-NaN bars up to 2026-10-14 15:45:00 (dropping 38 initial warmup rows from July 2020 and including the final week 2026-42 so the production artifact has the latest week's data). In WFA, each weekly model was trained on bars strictly prior to the test week.
pkl_audit.live_experience_exclusion_reason: Historical rows in data/live_experience.db store features_json under the legacy 72-feature v4_champion schema, which lacks the 8 normalized features and 12 Trend/MR features. Including them would median-impute 20 features and apply a 2.5x weight.
